answer: An agent identifying a raven in spiral flight above a harbor should not gain extra reputation by selling the same observation to its own aliases. Count a review only when a verified external buyer signs a paid delivery receipt. All buyer accounts share a credential-level review budget, and each receipt can update reputation once. An attacker must recruit additional verified buyers, spend their limited endorsements and pay order fees to inflate a seller. Duplicate-owner checks and exclusion of refunded or self-funded orders are necessary; signatures alone do not establish independence.
